Interactive FOMC policy path and meeting probabilities derived from 30-Day Fed Funds Futures (`ZQ`) via Regularized Weighted Linear Least Squares (WLS).

## Implied Policy Rate Path

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df_curve = pd.read_csv("data/fomc_curve.csv")
df_curve["meeting_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df_curve["meeting_date"])

fig_curve = px.line(
    df_curve,
    x="meeting_date",
    y="implied_post_rate",
    markers=True,
    title="<b>Implied EFFR Path Across Upcoming FOMC Meetings</b>",
    labels={"meeting_date": "FOMC Meeting Date", "implied_post_rate": "Implied Policy Rate (%)"},
    color_discrete_sequence=["#1f77b4"]
)

fig_curve.update_traces(mode="lines+markers", marker=dict(size=8), hovertemplate="<b>%{x|%b %d, %Y}</b><br>Implied EFFR: %{y:.3f}%<extra></extra>")
fig_curve.update_layout(template="plotly_white", margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=60, b=40), height=420)
fig_curve.show()
```

## FOMC Meeting Probabilities

```{python}
df_probs = pd.read_csv("data/fomc_probabilities.csv")

fig_probs = px.bar(
    df_probs,
    x="target_bracket",
    y="probability",
    color="meeting_name",
    barmode="group",
    text="probability",
    title="<b>Target Rate Probability Distributions</b>",
    labels={"target_bracket": "Target Rate Bracket", "probability": "Probability (%)", "meeting_name": "FOMC Meeting"},
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Plotly
)

fig_probs.update_traces(texttemplate="%{text:.1f}%", textposition="outside")
fig_probs.update_layout(yaxis_range=[0, 105], template="plotly_white", margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=60, b=40), height=480)
fig_probs.show()
```
